title: civica writing review checklist template
instructions: Record pass, finding, not_applicable or documented_deviation with evidence for every applicable rule. A MUST failure is a finding; proposed contract changes need review. Automated results do not prove complete accessibility or comprehension.

rules.scope: civica-authored content; preserve native Home Assistant strings and user-supplied names

rules.evidence_required: A source/implementation reference, reviewed copy or observed test result appropriate to this check.
